## What did you try or improve?

Describe your change, discovery, workaround, or experiment.

## What was the result?

What worked, what didn't, and how did you check?

## How can others try it? (optional)

Steps, configuration, a branch, fork, patch, logs, measurements, or screenshots.

## Environment (if relevant)

Hardware, OS, versions, dependencies or other setup details.

Even partial experiments are welcome. If you have a working change, you can also
[open a pull request](https://github.com/TUNA-NOPE/macbox/pulls).
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
